answer: All three F1 deps already declare it: desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f1-cli-contract-tests.md:7, task-rw-f1-model-contract-snapshot.md:7, task-rw-f1-output-golden-files.md:7. F2's prerequisite is transitively declared; no direct edge is needed.
_resolve_artifact_selector_multi already returns one Path and raises ValueError on >1 (operations.py:2621-2645); 'multi' means multiple search directories. No multi-match semantics exist to preserve.

_one_artifact_match (operations.py:2738-2742) takes an already-computed matches list and only raises on >1; it is not a resolver. Fix: let resolve_selector own both tiers and delete it (or delegate from _resolve_artifact_selector).

The artifact ids already exist as literals at the call sites: operations.py:492-493 ('artifact.task','artifact.pill'), 764, 1784, 2746. The executor passes the existing artifact_id argument through as `what`.

List is incomplete: PRIMITIVE_KINDS (operations.py:68-73) includes 'hook', reachable via show_primitive (operations.py:1013-1016, cli/commands/operations.py:250). Add 'hook'. _resolve_glob must also receive `what` from callers; its signature is only (directory, doc_id).

_resolve_glob builds its pattern internally (f"{doc_id}.md"/f"{doc_id}*.md", operations.py:2613-2616); artifact selectors use _artifact_glob_pattern (2599-2604): id_pattern with {slug}->'*' plus '.md', or '*.md' for inbox_note/board/ritual.
Pattern applies first: candidates come from glob/rglob(pattern) (operations.py:2625-2629, 2651-2652) and are only then filtered by name/stem (2631, 2653, 2657).

Tiers short-circuit: the first non-empty tier either returns or raises (operations.py:2631-2645), so candidates are that tier's matches. 'Behavior unchanged' settles this; only _one_artifact_match used dir-relative paths (2740).

All in-repo callers pass directories under desk_root (operations.py:492-493, 760 ARTIFACT_PATHS/drawer-pills, 1784, 2746-2755; cli/commands/operations.py:217), so relative_to(desk_root) cannot raise for current callers.
deskops/__init__.py holds only a docstring; no FAQ or doc contract requires listing new modules. Keep resolve_selector module-local; no export or docs change needed.
'The four methods become one-line delegations' plus 'F1 contract tests pass unchanged' already fixes signatures, names and return types.

Coverage floor, not exhaustive: add recursive True/False, multi-directory, and both message formats. Also the Done When grep hits ~14 unrelated glob/rglob uses (operations.py:542, 571, 635, 722, 2667), so it is interpretive.

Tests asserting the ambiguity text: tests/test_cli.py:646, 1297, 1314, 2240, 2259; all match the preserved prefix 'Ambiguous <artifact_id> selector' and keep passing. No test asserts the removed ' in {directory}' or 'No file found for id' text, so the closeout list may be empty.
